test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: UKCT is related to QGYP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LPBR is related to HLXN. To which of the following is DGYJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, UKCT is related to QGYP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1427ef8188119a0d4a6acf03913052071b60718db9a3d103ca0ed4325d59301.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc455a45718c4bae93bc2516ac8fd3e41912882ee4830f230175768e18f4b3ac.png] 

For, LPBR is related to HLXN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0dfc6bff8cf15b87b39006bf5cc5b6205ccea745f63f3a72644326a09df01a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18f51d009f9738667dbe65b8d73299ea98f3fe42fd414bea1632cf5f78ea0a2a.png] 

Similarly, for 'DGYJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e99790cb496e1d933f3150d0182f944fad57a006787d5c314fe9a6c56d1f214e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58fda91afdec58ba22988ac82d2a5a4c49f51f7f030acc3097a60c9c271e906f.png] 

So, 'DGYJ' will be related to 'ZCUF'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
